title: Document Workflow Classification & Extraction

label: For "Document Workflow Classification & Extraction": Classify and extract fields from uploaded documents (contracts, forms, invoices) to automate customer workflows. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Test documents from the same templates as training.
